theorem parallelogram_equality (a b c d e : Point) (AB CD AF BC : Line) 
(h1 : formParallelogram a b c d AB CD AF BC) 
(h2 : formParallelogram e b c d EB CD AF BC) 
(h3 : distinctPointsOnLine b c BC) 
(h4 : AF.intersectsLine BC) 
(h5 : EB.intersectsLine BC) 
(h6 : sameSide a e BC) 
(h7 : sameSide d e BC) : Triang.area △ a:b:c = Triang.area △ e:b:c := by
  -- Extracting properties from the parallelogram definitions
  obtain rfl := h1.1
  obtain rfl := h2.1
  -- Simplifying the goal based on the properties
  simp_all only [formParallelogram]
  -- Using the equality of areas due to same base and height
  congr 1
  <;> aesop

nl_statement: Parallelograms which are on the same base and between the same parallels are equal to one another. Let $ABCD$ and $EBCF$ be parallelograms on the same base $BC$, and between the same parallels $AF$ and $BC$. I say that $ABCD$ is equal to parallelogram $EBCF$. <prf> Thus, the whole parallelogram $ABCD$ is equal to the whole parallelogram $EBCF$.Thus, parallelograms which are on the same base and between the same parallels are equal to one another.
